method.scope: Only ctx-tra-059, ctx-tra-061, ctx-tra-076, ctx-tra-081, ctx-tra-086, ctx-tra-116, ctx-cal-030, ctx-cal-051 and ctx-cal-054 were adjudicated.
method.authority: DECISION_LOGIC.md, with the two-stage screening/context rubric and authored boundary fixtures.
procedure: Read authoritative rules before deciding the nine cases.

Read complete target and actual previous/next blocks, inspect the associated original posting sequence and membership, and verify source bindings. Full postings were used to identify unresolved references, never to silently enlarge the model's triplet.
Inspect original labels and independent reviewers' saved proposals; this is disclosed adjudication, not a blind review.

Apply relevance and scope before sponsorship; require explicit current-role sponsorship provision, and do not infer sponsorship from work authorization, generic exceptions, appointment eligibility or another role.

Exclude cases where the actual triplet cannot resolve binary relevance; preserve supported conservative labels where the target itself establishes relevant eligibility and ambiguity is the correct sponsorship outcome.
method.exclusionLabels: For excluded records the six final-label keys remain present, but relevance is null because no binary gold can be justified. Null is an audit marker, not a third relevance class. The other five values record only the supported conservative interpretation. Never export any excluded record as training/calibration gold.
method.inputReadBoundary: Train, development and calibration containers were read; semantic adjudication is restricted to the nine allowlisted records. Only their postings and membership entries were inspected. Fresh-test gold and fresh-test review artifacts were not inspected. The mixed postings/ledger files were fingerprinted as bytes; no fresh-test entry was used.
